title: Director Voss: Report Cyber Incident to State ESInet NOC

transcript.speaker: Director Karen Voss
transcript.text: This is Director Karen Voss, Rook County Emergency Communications District. I’m calling to report a confirmed cyber incident pattern on our 911 systems. We have a beaconing signal from IP 10.12.200.102, which is RCECD-POS09. The system is generating 37 silent calls per minute on SIP trunk group A, and we have confirmed ALI data corruption on CAD-MDS01. I need immediate call-source analysis and confirmation of overflow routing to Tamarack County Communications under MCTA-2025.

transcript.speaker: State ESInet NOC Operator
transcript.text: Understood, Director Voss. We’re routing your report to the cyber incident response team. We’ll initiate call-source analysis and confirm Tamarack’s readiness for overflow under MCTA-2025. Please hold for verification.

transcript.speaker: Director Karen Voss
transcript.text: Confirmed. We’re on standby for activation. Please advise when routing is confirmed. Thank you.

voiceStyles.Director Karen Voss: Woman in her 50s, calm but urgent, slight pause between sentences
voiceStyles.State ESInet NOC Operator: Male, neutral tone, background keyboard clicks

instructorNote: This is a critical SOP trigger: the Director must report to the state ESInet NOC per C3 and confirm MCTA-2025 activation. Watch for whether the team references OPS-DR-2 or the TICP for authority.
